_readme: Six ready-made agent graphs. Open the Graph Bench wizard → Graphs → paste this whole file into the Import box → Import. Each one loads as an editable graph.

graphs.name: Should we build this?
graphs.outcome: A one-page recommendation on whether this idea is worth testing, and what to test first.
graphs.decision: Whether I spend the next month on this idea.

jobs.name: Planner
jobs.job: Break the question into the angles that would actually change the answer.

jobs.name: Customer research
jobs.job: Find the real pain: what they use today, what it costs them, what they've already tried.

jobs.name: Competitor research
jobs.job: Map who already serves this — products, agencies, freelancers, spreadsheets.

jobs.name: Distribution research
jobs.job: Find where these buyers actually are and what search terms reveal intent.

jobs.name: Skeptic
jobs.job: Kill the weak claims: stale evidence, ignored competitors, pain confused with willingness to pay.

jobs.name: Merge
jobs.job: Turn the surviving evidence into pursue / pause / kill, plus the wedge and this week's test.

jobs.name: Human gate
jobs.job: Decide what happens next, and what evidence would change your mind.

skeptic.custom: Any market size number quoted without a source and a date.

graphs.gateWho: The recommendation and the one test we run this week.

graphs.name: Support triage
graphs.outcome: A reply that is accurate, on-policy, in our voice, and safe to send.
graphs.decision: Whether this reply goes out as written.

jobs.name: Classify
jobs.job: Billing, product confusion, bug, cancellation risk, or something else.

jobs.name: Account context
jobs.job: New or long-standing? High value? Written in before? Already frustrated?

jobs.name: Policy lookup
jobs.job: Find the governing policy in the docs or internal wiki. Quote it.

jobs.name: Draft reply
jobs.job: Write the reply using the account context and the policy — nothing invented.

jobs.name: Checker
jobs.job: Review for factual accuracy, tone, and risk. Flag anything we could regret.

jobs.name: Human gate
jobs.job: Approve. Mandatory for refunds, account changes, angry customers, legal risk.

skeptic.custom: Any promise about timing, pricing or a future feature.

graphs.gateWho: The exact words that go to the customer.

state.custom: Tag every run with the product area — this becomes the feedback pipeline

graphs.name: Episode build
graphs.outcome: A script plus a title, thumbnail direction and captions that sound like a person.
graphs.decision: Whether this goes into production this week.

jobs.name: Research
jobs.job: Gather what's actually being said on this topic right now.

jobs.name: Thesis
jobs.job: One sharp claim the whole piece defends.

jobs.name: Examples
jobs.job: Find specific, checkable examples — names, numbers, dates.

jobs.name: Hook
jobs.job: Write openings that earn attention in formats that are working now.

jobs.name: Script
jobs.job: Draft the script from the thesis, examples and hook.

jobs.name: Checker
jobs.job: Are the examples specific? Does the pacing work? Does it sound like a person?

jobs.name: Titles
jobs.job: Title options that match the thesis, not the topic.

jobs.name: Thumbnails
jobs.job: Thumbnail concepts, described well enough to hand to a designer.

jobs.name: Human gate
jobs.job: Approve the script and pick the title and thumbnail.

skeptic.custom: Any sentence that could have been written about any topic. Cut it.

graphs.gateWho: The script, the title and the thumbnail direction.

state.custom: ./content/<slug>/ — the examples file is the real asset, keep it forever

graphs.name: Ship it
graphs.outcome: A pull request that is safe to merge, with the evidence that says so.

jobs.name: Plan
jobs.job: State what changes, what must not change, and how we'll know it worked.

jobs.name: Implement
jobs.job: Make the change. Nothing else.

jobs.name: Review the diff
jobs.job: Read the diff as an adversary. Where does this break?

jobs.name: Run tests
jobs.job: Run the suite. Report failures verbatim — no summarising away a red build.

jobs.name: Check the UI
jobs.job: Drive the real screen. Does the change look and behave right?

jobs.name: Edge cases
jobs.job: Empty, huge, concurrent, offline, wrong-permission, non-ASCII.

jobs.name: Human gate
jobs.job: Approve the pull request.

skeptic.custom: Any test described as passing without the actual output pasted in.

graphs.gateWho: The diff and the test output.

state.custom: Attach review.md and tests.md to the PR description

graphs.name: What are they telling us?
graphs.outcome: The three themes worth acting on this quarter, with the quotes that prove them.

jobs.name: Planner
jobs.job: Define the sources and the window. What counts as a signal?

jobs.name: Tickets
jobs.job: Pull themes out of support tickets, with counts.

jobs.name: Interviews
jobs.job: Pull themes out of calls and interviews, with quotes.

jobs.name: Churn & cancels
jobs.job: Why people actually left, in their words.

jobs.name: Skeptic
jobs.job: Which themes are loud but rare? Which are one angry customer repeated?

jobs.name: Merge
jobs.job: Three themes, ranked, each with evidence and a proposed response.

jobs.name: Human gate
jobs.job: Decide what goes on the roadmap.

skeptic.custom: Any theme backed by fewer than three independent customers.

graphs.gateWho: The three themes and what we do about each.

state.custom: ./feedback/<quarter>/ — quotes carry forward to every future run

graphs.name: Call prep
graphs.outcome: A one-page brief: who they are, what they likely need, and the three questions to ask.

jobs.name: Planner
jobs.job: What do we need to know before this call to not waste it?

jobs.name: Company
jobs.job: What they do, size, recent news, how they make money.

jobs.name: People
jobs.job: Who's on the call, what they own, what they're measured on.

jobs.name: Fit & objections
jobs.job: Where we'd fit, and the objections that will come up.

jobs.name: Skeptic
jobs.job: What's guessed vs. sourced? What would embarrass us if it's wrong?

jobs.name: Merge
jobs.job: One page: context, hypothesis, three questions, the ask.

jobs.name: Human gate
jobs.job: Read the brief before the call. Cut anything you can't defend live.

skeptic.custom: Anything about a named person that isn't from a public source.

graphs.gateWho: The brief I'll actually have open during the call.

state.custom: ./calls/<company>/ — next call starts from the last brief
